### Scope battlefield

Ids 1 to 221. A data file reaches each table below as `battlefield.<id>.<name>.<record>` and not by its own name (data patches spec §6.2).

A battlefield map, by battlefield_map_id (MPINIT's ids 1..0x64 and 0xc9..0xdd; a region's map is G[0x8e0330 + region], a story battle's is set by DUINIT). FIELD walks the MPINIT chain G[0xa6b899] to fill these tables for the map in play; MPINIT writes only the map's cells and clears nothing.

| name | table |
|---|---|
| cell | battlefield_cell |
| entry | battlefield_entry |

## choice-output

| address | name | conf | source | usage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `0x213ef3` | current_scene_id | high | investigation | The scene to play: SCJUMP's rules set it with system_mode 1 (SCJUMP@0x1be..); the visit screens set it from a visit slot (ALLMAP@0x6fa, REIGN@0xafb and @0x1d90, PALACE@0x7ed); BROTHEL@0xfdb from a HAINIT array; GAMESTART@0x16d8 sets 0, the prologue. SYSTEM4@0x325 looks it up in scene_script_ids, and each scene script branches on it (SC0000@0xc66..0xceb). Not saved. |
| `0x213ef5` | scjump_chain_pending | high | investigation | The dispatch's open turn: a caller sets 0x7fffffff before it walks the SCJUMP chain (ALLMAP@0x57.., SYSTEM4@0x668), and the first rule whose condition holds clears it as it sets current_scene_id, so no later rule in the chain takes the turn (SCJUMP's rules test `G[0x213ef5] > 0`). Not saved. |

## counter

| address | name | conf | source | usage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `0x38a6` | scene_turns_since_played | high | investigation | Turns since a scene was played, by scene number: at each new turn ALLMAP@0x244c..0x248c adds 1 to the cell of every scene whose scene_played_flags cell is set, before it raises the turn counter G[0x170a4] (ALLMAP@0x248f). SCJUMP's rules test it 192 times, e.g. scene 206 needs G[0x3973] >= 2 (SCJUMP@0x1be). Saved. |
| `0x787b` | quest_battle_counts | med | investigation | Saved: how many times the quest's battle was started (CONQUEST@0x4ef..0x4fd); ALLMAP@0x1025 zeroes all 1000 at the turn change, so it counts this turn's (inferred). |
| `0x1622f` | costume_experience | high | investigation | Saved: a costume's experience toward the next level, out of 100 (RESULT@0x160d; DOLL@0x1aaf draws it with /100). |
| `0x1686f` | costume_stat_growth_remainders | med | investigation | Saved: hundredths of a costume's stat growth not yet applied; RESULT adds COINIT's G[0x2686ee] growth at a level-up, moves the whole part into costume_stats and keeps the rest (RESULT@0x1670..0x16dd). |
| `0x16cbb` | part_counts | high | investigation | Saved: how many of each part or costume the player holds, at most 999 (ADDPART@0x2a9..0x2df); a costume is 0 or 1 (ADDPART@0x16..0x6f). DOLL, ALCHEMY and QUEST read it; GAMECLEAR and GAMESTART carry it (G[0x63a4] bit 0x8). |
| `0x170a4` | turn_week | high | investigation | Saved: the week, the strategic map's turn count. INIT@0xa sets 1 and ALLMAP@0x248f raises it. QUEST@0xdfe compares quest_first_weeks with it. |
| `0x17120` | nation_funds | med | investigation | Saved: the nation's funds (資金). ADDCN@0x47 adds nation_start_funds; the turn adds income and takes costs (ALLMAP@0x1e9f..0x1ec2); RUSE@0x9f7 caps a funds cost by it; RECEIPT@0xc0e..0xc6c adds quest_reward_money; SHOP and others spend it. SAVE@0xaae copies the player's into the shared profile. |
| `0x1713e` | nation_provisions | med | investigation | Saved: the nation's provisions (兵糧; inferred from 流民保護's text, 資金と兵糧, and the second cost column RUSE@0xa39..0xa73 compares with it). ## index-pointer

| address | name | conf | source | usage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `0x0` | system_mode | high | investigation | SYSTEM4's mode loop (SYSTEM4@0x302..0x746): 1 a scene pass, 2 ALLMAP, 3 FIELD, 4 REIGN, 5 DEAL; any other value shows 不正な実行モード and asks to exit. A screen hands the turn to a scene by setting 1 (ALLMAP@0x6fa.., PALACE@0x801, SCJUMP's rules). Saved. |
| `0x1` | system_next_mode | high | investigation | The mode to return to after the scene: SYSTEM4@0x65c..0x663 copies it into system_mode when it is nonzero, then reruns the dispatch in the same context unless scjump_context_id is 2 or 7. ALLMAP sets 2 (ALLMAP@0x704), REIGN 4 (REIGN@0xb05, @0x1d9a), PALACE 5 (PALACE@0x7f7), BROTHEL 4 (BROTHEL@0xfe0); CONQUEST clears it before a battle (CONQUEST@0x4c5). Saved. |
| `0x2` | system_base_mode | high | investigation | The last mode other than a scene: SYSTEM4@0x68e..0x69c copies system_mode into it when that is not 1; the screens set it before a scene (REIGN@0xb00 4, PALACE@0x7f2 5, CONQUEST@0x4bb). INIT2@0x3a2..0x3eb reads it on a load inside a scene over the map, to rebuild the screen under it: READMAP for 2; READFIELD, READREIGN and READCH for 4. Saved. |
| `0xc5a` | current_scene_script_id | high | investigation | The script of the scene pass: SYSTEM4@0x317..0x33f sets it to scene_script_ids[current_scene_id], or SC0000 (0x56) where that is 0, unless scene_run_mode is set (TITLE's debug entries set it themselves); SYSTEM4@0x4f0 calls it. Saved. |
| `0xc5e` | scene_window_layout | high | investigation | The message window's layout for the scene pass: SYSTEM4@0x47a..0x4a3 sets 2 for a scene over the map (scene_over_map), 1 in the replay room (replay_room_active), 0 otherwise; SYSTEM4's label_74b (@0x74b..0x7ac) sets the two text origins for each. The scene scripts' own header sets it the same way ($1$SC4000@0xa83..0xaa0, DEBUGADV@0xa83). Saved. |
| `0x37d0` | adv_speaker_id | high | investigation | Saved. The page's speaker, a character id, or −1 for narration (SC0000@0xfe3); the name, voice setting and heard flag come from it. |
| `0x37d2` | adv_speaker_name_form | high | investigation | Saved. The column of character_name_forms the page draws (SC0000@0x1227, @0x10cfa); outside 0..5 it draws ？？？？; the heard flag is set only for form 0. |
| `0x37d3` | adv_face_shown | med | investigation | Saved. The face picture shown, a cache set_speaker_face keeps; −1 releases element 0xd (SC0000@0xa62). |
| `0x37d4` | scjump_context_id | high | investigation | SCJUMP's context, 1 to 13 (SCJUMP@0x0..0xb6): 1 the turn's start (ALLMAP@0x27ee), 2 the visits on offer (ALLMAP@0x2f7e, PALACE@0x9b7, REIGN@0x2845), 3 and 4 the world map (ALLMAP@0x292a, @0x29c1 and others), 5 and 6 internal affairs (REIGN@0x2c18, @0x2c97), 7 a battle begins (ALLMAP@0xb81), 8 a sortie (FIELD@0xab6 and others), 9 a retreat (FIELD@0x9ad0), 10 a victory (FIELD@0xefe2), 11 (ALLMAP@0x2885), 12 and 13 the turn's end (ALLMAP@0xe6a, @0xf01). SCINIT's scene_offer_contexts give the same numbers. Saved. |
| `0x639f` | nation_player | med | investigation | Saved: the player's nation. INIT sets 1; INITGAME@0x1a9..0x1b8 makes every other nation 敵対 when it is not 1. Read as the player's by SHOP, QUEST, RUSE, RECEIPT, PALACE and SHOWREL (SHOWREL@0x963). |
| `0x70a8` | facility_object | high | investigation | Saved: the object of the facility being visited; REIGN sets it (REIGN@0xac2), DEAL runs facility_scripts[G[0x8f1152 + it]] (DEAL@0x9b), ALCHEMY, BREED and QUEST read its kind for their variant. |
| `0x70a9` | facility_level | high | investigation | Saved: the level of the facility being visited, from G[0xb4420 + 400 x region + cell] (REIGN@0xac7..0xad2); SHINIT's offers and ALINIT's alchemy_required_facility_levels test it (ALCHEMY@0xf78). |
| `0x70aa` | quest_in_battle | med | investigation | Saved: the quest whose battle runs, 0 none. CONQUEST@0x4ea sets it; FIELD@0xf28c..0xf2a8 sets its bit 2 when G[0xc078] equals G[0xc535]; ALLMAP and 14 scene scripts clear it. |
| `0xc077` | battle_id | med | investigation | Saved: the battle FIELD sets up; DUINIT branches on it (115 branches, `$1$DUINIT` 4 more). Story scenes set it (17 scripts); otherwise FIELD@0x1ce..0x1ed takes region_battles, and CONQUEST@0x4d6 quest_battles. |
| `0x170a5` | turn_nation | high | investigation | Saved: the nation whose turn it is, 0 between turns; the player first, then each other active nation in id order (ALLMAP@0xf85..0x1009). INIT@0xf sets 0. ALLMAP@0x644d draws its picture; EXECRUSE and RUSEJUDGE act for it. |
| `0x211c17` | adv_face_picture | high | investigation | The page's face picture, −1 for none (SC0000@0xe05). Not saved. |
| `0x211c18` | adv_voice_clip | high | investigation | The page's voice clip; cleared when voice_mute_switches[adv_voice_setting] is set (SC0000@0x12fa..0x1309); history metadata 5. Not saved. |
| `0x211c90` | adv_voice_setting | high | investigation | The voiced page's voice setting, 0 for narration (SC0000@0x129d, @0x12f5); history metadata 4. Not saved. |
| `0x22ab3f` | voice_setting_in_play | high | investigation | The voice setting the page chose (SC0000@0x12cb..0x12f0); not saved. |
| `0x22c31a` | extras_room_page | med | investigation | ROOM's page: 0 CGMODE, 1 HMODE, 2 MMODE, 3 INFO2 (ROOM@0x1b..0x6b); ROOM loops while it is 0 or more and then soft-resets (ROOM@0x71..0x8e). Not saved. |
| `0x22c3d0` | tutorial_screen | high | investigation | The screen asking TUTORIAL for a tutorial: 1 and 2 FIELD (FIELD@0xa51, @0xb58), 3 ALLMAP (ALLMAP@0x2cc), 4 REIGN (REIGN@0x2b9); compared with tutorial_screens. Not saved. |
| `0x22c3d1` | tutorial_current | high | investigation | The tutorial TUTORIAL has chosen; TUMES branches on it for the text (TUMES@0x0). Not saved. |

## story-flag

| address | name | conf | source | usage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `0xc71` | scene_played_flags | high | investigation | Played scenes, by scene number: each scene's branch sets its cell to 1 as it starts (1150 branches, every one G[0xc71 + its number]; SC0000@0xcf2). SCJUMP's rules test them most (4401 tests of 864 cells): a scene is offered while its own is not 1 and once others are. Numbers SCINIT does not use are story flags too: G[0x2801] (SC0200@0x10949, tested by 630 rules), G[0x27ff] and G[0x2800] (SC0220@0x3ffb, @0x4451), G[0x2802] (READY@0x438). TUTORIAL@0x498 tests them. Saved. |

## ui-toggle

| address | name | conf | source | usage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GS 0x1a7` | message_font_name | high | investigation | The message font, メイリオ by default (INITCONFIG@0x0). SYSTEM4@0x2c9 sets it with set-font; CHECKCONFIG@0x0..0x18 puts ＭＳ 明朝 in its place when it is not installed. Saved, and kept in the shared profile. |
| `GS 0x1a8` | ui_font_name | high | investigation | The screens' font, ＭＳ ゴシック by default (INITCONFIG@0x8): ALCHEMY, ALLMAP, ARMAMENT, BREED, CONQUEST and the other screens set it. CHECKCONFIG@0x1b..0x33 puts ＭＳ ゴシック back when it is not installed. Saved, and kept in the shared profile. |
| `0xc56` | confirm_save_load | high | investigation | 1 by default (INITCONFIG@0x10). While it is above 0, SAVE asks ロードしますか？ or セーブしますか？ before it loads or saves (SAVE@0x6fc, @0x7c1). Saved, and kept in the shared profile. |
| `0x33e7` | voice_mute_switches | high | investigation | Saved and kept in the shared profile: 1 mutes the voice setting (SC0000@0x1309); CONFIG2@0x82f loads them, @0x851 toggles one. |
| `0x37d1` | adv_page_has_text | med | investigation | Saved. 1 once a page has text: every page template sets it first (SC0000@0x8f6). |
| `0x38a5` | scene_over_map | high | investigation | 1 while the scene plays over the map, not in the ADV screen: the screens copy scene_on_map_flags[scene] into it as they hand a scene over (ALLMAP@0x6dd4 and others). SYSTEM4@0x47a picks the message window by it, and INIT2@0x3a2 rebuilds the map under such a scene on a load. Saved. |
| `0x63b0` | confirm_commands | high | investigation | 1 by default (INITCONFIG@0x18). While it is set, a command asks first: タイトル画面に戻りますか？ (MENU@0x592), 討伐戦を開始しますか？ and 戦闘を放棄して撤退しますか？ (CONQUEST); ORGANIZE reads it too. Saved, and kept in the shared profile. |
| `0x63b3` | autosave_off | med | investigation | 0 by default (INITCONFIG@0x28). ALLMAP autosaves (its comment オートセーブ実行, ALLMAP@0x2add) only while it is 0 and G[0xc58] is 0 (ALLMAP@0x2ac1..0x2ad6). Saved, and kept in the shared profile. |
| `0x63b7` | message_window_colour | med | investigation | The message window's colour, 0 by default (INITCONFIG@0x50): a scene draws the window with it, gfx-draw-color 0xd2f0 0 (alpha G[0x211c12]) (colour G[0x63b7]) (SC0000@0xf6e9, @0xf729); BUNKI, HISTORY and HMODE read it too. Saved, and kept in the shared profile. |
| `0x63b8` | voice_continues_past_page | med | investigation | 1 by default (INITCONFIG@0x58). While it is 0, a page's end resets the voice (reset-message-voice-state, SC0000@0x1030b, @0x104c3), so the voice stops when the page turns. Saved, and kept in the shared profile. |
| `0x63b9` | speaker_text_colour_mode | high | investigation | 1 by default (INITCONFIG@0x48). 1: a page's text takes the speaker's effect colour from G[0x63ba] (CHECKCONFIG@0x52..0xd7, SC0000@0x10c1a); -1: white text, render mode 1, no effect offset (CHECKCONFIG@0xdf..0xfe); any other value keeps 0x3a3a3a. Saved, and kept in the shared profile. |
